approval.scope: The owner approves registration v2 for FUTURE hair sheets: fit on A4 (centreHairline), A9 (leftEarTopJunction) and A10 (rightEarTopJunction) with ONE positive uniform scale and translation; A7 and A8 are mandatory shape-check points, not fit points; every other point is a reported check point. The coordinates are D-174's, unchanged. The approval covers roles and targets only - not a hair form, not an envelope, not a source anchor on any sheet, and not the D-177 sheet.
approval.statusNote: Only the owner may set APPROVED. Any coordinate change is a new targets version with a new pin and a new owner decision.

derivedFrom.rule: Every points[k].xy, id, kind, source and uncertainty and the whole geometry block are copied unchanged from targets-hair-v1.json; only role changes (the v1 role is kept as roleV1). v1 stays in force, unchanged, for D-174 .. D-178.

coordinates: master canvas, continuous: pixel i covers [i, i+1); x right, y down
units: MASTER px (1024x1536). Source annotations on a sheet are SHEET px and are converted with the fitted scale s (a sheet uncertainty u is u * s master px).
provenance: A1..A9 are MEASURED_ANNOTATION readings on Northstar Master v2 (about +/-3 px). A10 is a DESIGN_POINT reconstructed on the adopted head geometry (the midpoint of the v2 silhouette ends that close v1's 6 exposed scalp px), not a Northstar reading; it keeps that status as a fit point.

source.rule: points[k].xy === source.namedPoints[k] exactly; geometry.sketchSilhouette === outerVolume ++ fringeEdge; geometry.napeLock === designProposals.rightNapeLock.polygon

geometry.sketchSilhouetteStatus: REVIEW-ONLY v2 sketch (DRAFT). It is NOT approved as a hair form and NOT a binding envelope. D-174 uses it for exactly two things: the ear-top area (HP8: the V3 ear columns inside this polygon grown 3 px) and the BROAD diagnostic envelope (grown 24 px, reported only).
geometry.napeLockStatus: PLANNED part of the hair design (D-174). The free-standing sketch is NOT an approved shape; its final connection is judged against an underlay with a neck before any production approval. Diagnostic only in the checks.

napeLockV2: Under registration v2 the lock under the image-right ear is NOT part of the main hair sheet. It is a later, separate authoring part that waits for an underlay with a neck, gets its own registration then, and is merged into the SAME hair luminance layer - no new runtime layer. geometry.napeLock is kept unchanged as the v1 diagnostic reference.
